description: Draws borders around and/or inside a grid range. top/bottom/left/right are the range's outer edges; inner_horizontal/inner_vertical are the grid lines between cells inside it. Each side takes {style, color?} — styles SOLID, SOLID_MEDIUM, SOLID_THICK, DOTTED, DASHED, DOUBLE, or NONE to remove that side's border. Only the provided sides change; at least one is required. Colors are "#RRGGBB" hex (default black).

style.description: Line style; NONE removes the border on that side.

inner_horizontal.description: Horizontal lines between rows inside the range.

style.description: Line style; NONE removes the border on that side.

inner_vertical.description: Vertical lines between columns inside the range.

style.description: Line style; NONE removes the border on that side.
Line style; NONE removes the border on that side.

range.description: Cell rectangle in grid coordinates: rows 1-10 × columns A-B = {start_row_index:0, end_row_index:10, start_column_index:0, end_column_index:2}.

end_column_index.description: End column, exclusive (omit = to the last column).

end_row_index.description: End row, exclusive (omit = to the last row).

sheet_id.description: The numeric sheetId from get_spreadsheet (not the title).

start_row_index.description: First row, 0-based inclusive (omit = from the top).

style.description: Line style; NONE removes the border on that side.

spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<spreadsheetId>/edit) or from create_spreadsheet / search_spreadsheets output.

style.description: Line style; NONE removes the border on that side.

name: set_borders
title: Set cell borders
